name: The Fen Breath
_doc: Expansion 1 (Vharlen). The ZONE EVENT BOSS for Fumarole Fen: at dusk the fen breathes out, and this time the breath stood up. P1 'Low Mist': a choking cone, marsh-light gas balls on random players, and a slow sigh that hangs poison over the ground. P2 at 55% 'The Choking': it hides in a ward of thick gas while wisps drift in — LIGHT ALL FOUR MARSH LAMPS to burn the gas off — and gas tides leave poison where they roll. P3, a new health bar 'The Last Breath': it inhales (everything slides toward it) then exhales a blast (run out), two players must cap each vent, and spinning lines of gas. Soft enrage from 4 minutes, hard at 7. OWNER #51 (2026-10-15): the phase that refilled the health bar is removed; the health bar is the whole fight.
party: Zone event, everyone nearby joins. Solo: not intended (four lamps under wisps, a soak of 2). 3-5: playable. 10+: intended. M5 scaling: health and wisps by players enrolled; soak need = clamp(players/5, 2, 4).

pull: The fen breathes out. The breath does not go away.
Every fumarole in the fen sighs at once, and the steam takes a shape.
The reeds bend toward the vent. Something is breathing in.
say.death: The Fen Breath thins, wavers, and is only mist over the water.
say.reset: The Fen Breath sinks back into the vents.

enrage.say: The whole fen exhales at once!

soft.say: The air turns thick and yellow. Every breath stings.

marsh_lights.name: Marsh Lights
marsh_lights.say: Pale lights drift toward you over the water!

sigh.name: Long Sigh
sigh.say: It sighs, and the gas settles where it falls.

wisps.name: Drifting Wisps
wisps.say: More wisps drift in from the vents!

gas_tide.name: Gas Tide
gas_tide.say: Gas rolls across the fen in a wall — step out of it!

phases.name: The Choking
phases.say: The Fen Breath pulls the gas round itself like a cloak!

ward.say: The Fen Breath hides in a ward of thick gas. Light all four marsh lamps to burn it off! It fails by itself in 25 seconds.
ward.fade: The ward fails by itself. No opening this time.

onEnter.say: The Fen Breath hides in a ward of thick gas. Light all four marsh lamps to burn it off! It fails by itself in 25 seconds.

do.say: Four marsh lamps flare! The gas round the Fen Breath catches and burns away!
